messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Chris Wang <chris.wang@acmecorp.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme procurement + security follow-up / PO vs card / Marketplace

Hi Chris —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement readiness and the commercial path. Please correct me if I missed anything.

Recap from our discovery:
- Primary use: product search & summarization for internal knowledge base (500k docs).
- Latency target: p95 < 350ms for interactive flows.
- Compliance gating: SOC 2 Type II report and a signed DPA required before procurement finalization.
- Procurement path options you mentioned: PO/Net terms via centralized procurement or company card for initial POC. Also mentioned potential interest in deploying via the AWS Marketplace.

Open items / asks from your side:
1) Confirmation whether procurement requires a formal SOW or just a PO referencing our master services agreement.
2) If procurement wants PO, target payment terms (Net30/Net45) and billing contact.
3) Security: please share the security questionnaire or the specific sections that will gate sign-off (encryption, data residency, access controls).
4) Marketplace: are you looking for a consolidated invoice via marketplace or prefer direct billing to Redwood?

What we can provide immediately:
- Attached: SOC 2 Type II report stub (redacted), draft DPA, and a procurement checklist that covers typical docs procurement teams request.
- If you want a quick path for immediate evaluation, we can set up a 30-day card-based pilot environment while procurement reviews contracts; we'll apply any committed spend against an eventual PO if you go that route.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm procurement preference (PO vs card) and security questionnaire owners by EOD Friday.
- I'll loop in our legal and finance leads once you confirm the preferred path (if PO, I'll send the billing/contact template).
- If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min joint call with your procurement/security folks next week to walk the checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Procurement prefers a PO for any production contract. For an initial POC/demo, we can use a company card. PO would reference your Master Services Agreement (if that’s ok).
2) Payment terms: Procurement is targeting Net30. Billing contact is Alicia Ramirez (cc'd).
3) Security questionnaire: we have a standard vendor security assessment (attached in my reply) — primary gating sections are: data encryption (in transit & at rest), access controls (IAM + audit logs), incident response, and subprocessor list + DPA. Our security team will want to review the full SOC 2 report but they can start with the redacted stub you provided.
4) Marketplace: we prefer direct billing first; Marketplace would be considered later for consolidated procurement across teams.

Next steps on our side: Alicia will coordinate the PO and procurement timeline. We should get you an ETA on the PO by next Wed (8/12). Security will send the completed questionnaire back to you within 5 business days — I’ll introduce the main security reviewer in that thread.

Thanks — will loop back ASAP.

—Chris
